changes: Kept V72 as the project baseline; only Ambient Light was changed.
Spread now expands the ambient host outward around the actual player instead of only changing blur inside the player rectangle.
At 0% the ambient source stays exactly on the player; higher spread values expand toward the visible viewport edges without enlarging the real video element.
Ambient layer z-index was raised above page surfaces but kept below the real VK Video player, so the outside glow remains visible without covering the video.
Blur range was extended to 0-1500 so stronger spread can fill larger visible areas smoothly.
Realtime rendering now uses requestVideoFrameCallback when the browser provides it, removing the previous fixed 24 FPS sampling delay; RAF fallback remains available.
Source sampling resolution was increased from 48x27 to 96x54 to reduce visible pixelation while preserving the V72 architecture and controls.
Existing V72 defaults remain: spread 0%, blur 100 and the other settings unchanged.
